idea: PRF hashes pad || key || address. With n = 32 the first block depends only on the key, and F uses the same key twice, H three times. Keep the state after that block: 4 compressions per F instead of 6, 6 per H instead of 9.

idea: The reference traversal has a trade-off parameter k (default 0): keeping 2^k - k - 1 more nodes per tree cuts the tree-hash steps per signature from h/2 to (h - k)/2.

idea: With the SHA accelerator the cost is register traffic and byte-order conversion. Its registers hold hash values and blocks as plain bytes, so PRF, F and H can pass outputs on as words: load the cached PRF state, write the address block, run; change one word, run; write the key block and start; write the next block while the previous one is compressed.
